Book-Title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Description: An orphaned boy discovers he is a wizard and begins his first year at a magical school.

Book-Title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
Description: A wizard student returns to school where a hidden chamber and a mysterious monster threaten classmates.

Book-Title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
Description: A dangerous escaped prisoner is rumoured to be hunting a young wizard at his magical school.
A comfortable hobbit joins a company of dwarves on a quest to reclaim a treasure guarded by a dragon.
A small group sets out to destroy a powerful ring before a dark lord can reclaim it.
The fellowship is broken and its members face separate battles while the ring bearer journeys onward.

Book-Title: The Lion the Witch and the Wardrobe
Description: Four siblings step through a wardrobe into a snowbound land ruled by a wicked witch.
Noble families fight for the throne of a kingdom while an ancient threat gathers in the north.
A gifted young man who becomes a legendary wizard tells the story of his own life.

Book-Title: Percy Jackson and the Lightning Thief
Description: A boy learns he is the son of a Greek god and must prevent a war among the gods.
A farm boy finds a dragon egg and is drawn into a rebellion against a tyrant king.
A young noble's family takes control of a desert planet that produces the most valuable substance in the universe.
A mathematician predicts the fall of a galactic empire and creates a plan to shorten the dark age that follows.
A gifted child is trained in a military school to command fleets against an alien enemy.
A washed-up hacker is hired for a final job inside a vast computer network.

Book-Title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
Description: An ordinary man is swept into space moments before Earth is destroyed to build a bypass.
A clerk living under constant surveillance in a totalitarian state begins to rebel in secret.
A future society keeps its citizens content through engineered classes and conditioning and drugs.
A teenage girl volunteers to fight to the death in a televised contest run by a harsh government.
A fireman whose job is to burn books starts to question the society he serves.
An astronaut stranded alone on Mars must use science and humour to survive until rescue.

Book-Title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
Description: A journalist and a young hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance in a wealthy family.
A man becomes the prime suspect when his wife disappears on their wedding anniversary.
A symbologist races to decode clues hidden in famous artworks after a murder in a museum.
A symbologist is called to decipher a secret brotherhood's threat against the Vatican.
Ten strangers are invited to an island and are killed one by one according to a nursery rhyme.
A famous detective investigates a murder aboard a snowbound luxury train.
A detective and his friend investigate a family curse and a ghostly hound on the moors.
A spirited young woman and a proud gentleman overcome their first impressions in Regency England.
A confident young woman plays matchmaker for her friends and misreads her own heart.
An orphaned governess falls in love with her mysterious employer who hides a dark secret.
A lawyer defends a wrongly accused man in a small Southern town as seen by his young daughter.
A mysterious millionaire throws lavish parties in pursuit of a lost love in Jazz Age New York.
A teenager wanders New York after leaving school and struggles with the phoniness of adults.
Several generations of a family in the town of Macondo live through love and war and solitude.
A shepherd boy travels in search of treasure and learns to follow his personal legend.
A sweeping history of how humans came to dominate the planet through cognition and cooperation.
A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through small daily changes.
A Nobel laureate explains the two systems of thought that shape our judgments and decisions.
An exploration of the science of habits and how people and companies can change them.
A woman raised by survivalists without formal schooling goes on to earn a doctorate.
A physicist explains black holes and the big bang and the nature of time for general readers.
A guided tour of the universe and humanity's search to understand its place in it.
An argument that evolution is best understood from the point of view of genes.
Two teenagers who meet in a cancer support group fall in love and travel to Amsterdam.
A teenager at a boarding school is drawn to a charismatic girl and her mysterious past.
A teenage girl moves to a rainy town and falls for a mysterious vampire classmate.
A young woman takes a job caring for a paralysed man and changes both their lives.
A family caretaking an isolated hotel over winter is terrorised by the building's malevolent past.
A group of childhood friends reunite as adults to fight a shape-shifting evil in their hometown.
A solicitor's visit to a Transylvanian count unleashes a vampire on Victorian England.
A scientist creates a living being from dead matter and is haunted by the consequences.
